company.name: Candyman
company.based_out_of: South Africa (city not stated on its website)
company.distributes: Jelly sweets, retro sweets, chocolate, international sweets, pick and mix and sweet gift boxes
company.channels_supplied: Its own online shop with nationwide delivery to shoppers, plus wholesale packs for retailers, events and businesses
what_they_do_well: Selling sweets to shoppers across South Africa since 2007, according to its About page.
company.fit_rationale: An online sweet shop with a gift boxes and international treats range, sourced from other suppliers and delivered anywhere in South Africa, including Pretoria. It sells both to shoppers and in wholesale quantities to retailers and events, so Diablo's gift boxes and sweets could reach gift buyers and small shops through one partner. Brands carried are not named on its website.

company.name: Enduroplanet
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Bicycles, parts and training gear, with a training and nutrition section selling energy bars and protein bars (High5, Enduren, Cadence), gels, drink and race mixes
company.channels_supplied: Its own shop at Pretty Gardens, Langenhovenpark, Bloemfontein and its own online shop
what_they_do_well: The only Trek retailer listed in Bloemfontein on Trek's South African store finder.
company.fit_rationale: An established Bloemfontein bicycle shop and Trek retailer whose own online shop has a bars section with other brands' energy and protein bars from High5, Enduren and Cadence. It sells to health-conscious cyclists and athletes, a natural shelf for Diablo's muesli and cereal bars. Tier 3 because it is a single store; store count beyond the one shop is not stated on its website.

company.name: Flowers PE
company.distributes: Branded chocolates and gift boxes (Lindt, Ferrero Rocher, Sally Williams nougat), snack boxes, tuck boxes and seasonal Valentine's and Mother's Day hampers, alongside flowers
company.channels_supplied: Its own shop at 43C 4th Avenue, Newton Park, and its online shop, with same-day delivery in Gqeberha, Despatch and Uitenhage
what_they_do_well: Makes up hampers daily for same-day collection or delivery across Gqeberha, Despatch and Uitenhage.
company.fit_rationale: A Gqeberha florist and gift shop with its own chocolates category of nine branded products and hampers made up daily, so a Diablo gift box or chocolate box fits its seasonal Valentine's, Mother's Day and Christmas gifting. It is small and reaches only shoppers in Nelson Mandela Bay, and it carries no sugar-free range today. Number of shops is one.

company.name: Huize Bloemfontein
company.distributes: Snack hampers and snack hamper boxes (15 lines), biltong and snack hampers, celebration, seasonal and deluxe hampers, coffee and tea hampers, alongside a florist, deli, coffee shop and bridal boutique.
company.channels_supplied: Sells direct to shoppers and businesses from its Bloemfontein shop and online shop, with same-day delivery across Bloemfontein for orders before 12:00 and custom hampers on request for a quote.
what_they_do_well: Runs florist, gift shop, deli, coffee shop and bridal boutique under one roof in Bloemfontein, with same-day delivery across the city.
company.fit_rationale: A Bloemfontein gift shop with a dedicated snack hamper range of 15 lines and custom curated hampers, which buys in packaged treats and sells them as gifts in the city. Diablo's chocolate, sweets and biscuit gift packs suit its snack, celebration and seasonal hampers for health-conscious and diabetic recipients. Tier 3 because it is a single shop and its website does not name the brands inside its hampers. Storage: sells from its own shop stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: MyCandies
company.based_out_of: South Africa (city not stated on its website)
company.distributes: Gummies and jelly sweets, jelly beans, lollipops and personalised candy gift boxes and tubs, with Festive, Valentine's, Easter and year end gifting ranges; brands include Kings Gummies and Yummy Gummy
company.channels_supplied: Own online shop delivering throughout South Africa, including the Eastern Cape, to shoppers and companies ordering gifts
what_they_do_well: Runs seasonal gifting ranges for Festive, Valentine's, Easter and year end.
Offers personalised candy gift boxes and tubs for companies and events.
company.fit_rationale: A family-run online candy gifting shop selling other brands' gummies and jelly sweets in seasonal gift boxes, which matches Diablo's gummies and gifting lines. It is small and its range is narrow, and it does not state its home city, hence tier 3.

company.name: Onela Vending
company.distributes: Packaged snacks and cold drinks through its own snack vending machines, plus hot drinks machines
company.channels_supplied: Corporate clients in the Eastern Cape, through vending machines placed in offices and workplaces
what_they_do_well: Offers a 24-hour response time for restocking and issues, with free delivery, installation and servicing of machines.
company.fit_rationale: An Eastern Cape snack vending operator that places snack and drink machines with corporate clients, sources the vending products and restocks the machines itself within 24 hours, so Diablo's bars, chocolate and biscuits could go straight into workplace machines. It is small and founded in 2021, and its website names no snack brands or exact town. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Rosella Flowers
company.distributes: Flowers with chocolate gift boxes, chocolate bouquets and chocolate and sweets gift boxes from Ferrero Rocher, Raffaello and Lindt Lindor, plus gift bundles and cakes.
company.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers through its own web shop, app and WhatsApp, with delivery in Polokwane, Gauteng and Cape Town; corporate gifts.
what_they_do_well: Runs its own Polokwane delivery alongside Gauteng and Cape Town, ordered through its website, app or WhatsApp.
company.fit_rationale: A Polokwane florist and gift shop whose own shop sells several chocolate and sweets gift boxes built on other brands such as Ferrero and Lindt. Diablo's chocolate boxes, pralines and gift boxes suit its gift bundles and corporate gifts for health-conscious recipients. Store count and walk-in shop are not stated on its website.

company.name: To Be Gift Boxes
company.distributes: Gift boxes and hampers with branded chocolate bars (Lindt slabs, Toblerone), chocolate nougat, chocolate coated nougat biscuits (Wedgewood Angels), cookies and shortbread biscuits (Mama Mac's), sold as boxes or single sweet treat add-ons
company.channels_supplied: Direct to consumers and companies through its own online shop, corporate and event gift boxes, and its shop at Castle Gate Shopping Centre, Pretoria; nationwide delivery
what_they_do_well: Lets clients build their own gift box within a set budget, with branded sweet treats sold as single add-ons.
Offers corporate and event gift boxes with nationwide delivery from its own warehouse.
company.fit_rationale: A build your own gift box company that buys branded chocolate, nougat, biscuits and cookies from other brands and sells them in corporate and personal gift boxes, so Diablo's chocolate, biscuits and gift boxes fit straight into its sweet treat range. It states nationwide delivery in South Africa, which covers Polokwane; Polokwane is not named on its website. Storage: ships from its own warehouse, listed at Ryneveld Lifestyle Centre, Centurion.

company.name: Waltons
company.distributes: Sweets, biscuits and snacks in a Refreshments and Catering section (Snacks, Sweet Treats), for example Endearmints wrapped sweets, Sweets from Heaven gummies, Bakers Choice assorted biscuits and Pyotts Snacktime biscuits, alongside coffee, tea and office supplies.
company.channels_supplied: Offices and businesses through over 60 stores nationwide, including a Gqeberha store with click and collect, and its online shop.
what_they_do_well: Runs over 60 stores nationwide with click and collect in Gqeberha.
Sells branded office snacks such as Endearmints sweets and Pyotts biscuits online.
company.fit_rationale: Waltons is a national office supplier of the Bidvest Group that sells other companies' branded sweets and biscuits to workplaces from its own online shop and stores, including one in Gqeberha. A sugar-free sweets, biscuit and bar range suits its Refreshments and Catering shelf for health-conscious offices. Storage: sells from its own stock through its stores and online shop, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: The Little Box Company
company.distributes: Gift boxes and hampers filled with branded chocolate (Ferrero Rocher, Raffaello, Toblerone), sweets and nougat (1701 Nougat, Darling Sweet caramels, Wedgewood, Sweet Melody fudge), biscuits (biscotti) and snacks
company.channels_supplied: Its own online gift shop, with delivery across South Africa to individual and corporate buyers; seasonal boxes for Valentine's Day and Father's Day
what_they_do_well: Has run its gift box business from Johannesburg since 2003, delivering nationwide.
company.fit_rationale: A Johannesburg online gift shop whose seasonal and occasion boxes are built from other companies' branded chocolate, sweets and biscuits, bought in and resold to shoppers. Diablo's gift boxes, chocolate and sweets would give it a sugar-free box for diabetic and health-conscious recipients, which its range does not show today. Single online shop, so its reach is limited to its own customers.

company.name: The Vending Company
company.distributes: Snack vending with confectionery and beverages
company.channels_supplied: Offices, call centres and companies, plus independent vending operators across Africa
what_they_do_well: More than 18 years in vending, with in-house merchandisers stocking machines.
company.fit_rationale: Family-owned vending operator that runs a fully managed service with its own merchandisers stocking confectionery in workplace machines, and supports independent operators. Its website does not name the brands it stocks or its head office city. Storage: buys and holds the stock its merchandisers load, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: TotalEnergies Marketing South Africa (Cafe Bonjour shops)
company.distributes: Snacks, drinks, groceries and hygiene products in its station shops, plus pastries, sandwiches and pies in Cafe Bonjour
company.channels_supplied: Cafe Bonjour shops at TotalEnergies service stations nationwide; some sites host OK Express stores
what_they_do_well: Runs one of South Africa's larger forecourt networks, with over 547 service stations as of 2025.
company.fit_rationale: Its own website says its station stores sell snacks, drinks and groceries alongside the Cafe Bonjour counter, across a network of over 547 service stations. The shop brand is run under one national banner, so it offers a central route into forecourt shops; the number of stations with a Bonjour shop and the buying model are not stated on its website.

company.name: Toys R Us South Africa
company.distributes: Toys and gifts with a party and gifting 'Sweets & Snacks' section: novelty candy (Kidsmania, Candy Toys, Paw Patrol candy) and Sweets from Heaven gummies
company.channels_supplied: 19 Toys R Us and Babies R Us stores (formerly ToyZone), including Fourways Mall and Mall of Africa in Johannesburg, plus its online shop
what_they_do_well: Runs 19 stores nationally after the ToyZone chain became Toys R Us and Babies R Us South Africa.
company.fit_rationale: A national toy and gift chain whose own online shop runs a 'Sweets & Snacks' section under party and gifting, stocking other companies' candy brands. Diablo's gummies, advent calendars and gift boxes fit its seasonal and party gifting shelf. Tier 3 because the sweets range is small (15 lines) and the operating company and head office are not named on its website.

company.name: Vending Solutions
company.distributes: Snacks, chocolate and drinks in snack and combination machines, smart fridges and automated canteens; also sells snacks and drinks to other operators through its consumables shop
company.channels_supplied: Workplace vending in corporate offices, hospitals and clinics, student accommodation, industrial sites, transport hubs, hospitality and education, nationwide; independent vending operators through its business opportunity and consumables shop
company.sf_brands_carried: Its Healthy Vending site lists third-party better-for-you brands for operators, such as RUSH bars, Earthshine and The Chocolate Tree; no direct competitor seen
what_they_do_well: Trading since 1996 with ISO 9001 and ISO 45001 certification and B-BBEE Level 1.
Client logos include MTN, Vodacom, PwC, KPMG, Anglo American and the University of Johannesburg.
company.fit_rationale: A national full-service operator since 1996 that installs, stocks and services snack machines with its own merchandisers and also supplies snack stock to the operators it sets up. It serves workplaces nationwide and runs a dedicated healthy vending line, so sugar-free chocolate, bars and biscuits suit both routes. Storage: sells from its own stock through its consumables shop and merchandiser routes, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Waltons
company.distributes: Sweets, biscuits and snacks in a Refreshments and Catering section (Snacks, Sweet Treats), for example Endearmints wrapped sweets, Sweets from Heaven gummies, Bakers Choice assorted biscuits and Pyotts Snacktime biscuits, alongside coffee, tea and office supplies.
company.channels_supplied: Offices and businesses through over 60 stores nationwide, including a Gqeberha store with click and collect, and its online shop.
what_they_do_well: Runs over 60 stores nationwide with click and collect in Gqeberha.
Sells branded office snacks such as Endearmints sweets and Pyotts biscuits online.
company.fit_rationale: Waltons is a national office supplier of the Bidvest Group that sells other companies' branded sweets and biscuits to workplaces from its own online shop and stores, including one in Gqeberha. A sugar-free sweets, biscuit and bar range suits its Refreshments and Catering shelf for health-conscious offices. Storage: sells from its own stock through its stores and online shop, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: West Pack Lifestyle
company.distributes: Party, gifting and occasion goods with a sweets and chocolates section (Mister Sweet sweets, mixed sweet bags, party packs) and a savoury snacks section
company.channels_supplied: Its own West Pack Lifestyle and Express stores, including Fourways and Randpark Ridge in Johannesburg, and its online shop
what_they_do_well: Grew to about 31 stores across four South African provinces by 2017, opening Lifestyle stores such as Fourways View.
company.fit_rationale: A party, gifting and lifestyle chain with stores in Johannesburg whose own website has 'Sweets And Chocolates', 'Sweets' and 'Snack, Sip & Treat' categories stocking other brands such as Mister Sweet. Diablo's gummies, sweets and gift boxes suit its party and seasonal shelf. Store count was about 31 across four provinces in 2017; the current count and head office are not stated on its website.
